assertions.assertion: An authorization policy named 'admin' is defined using RequireRole("admin")
assertions.rationale: Policy named "AdminOnly", not 'admin' (RequireRole("admin") is present but the name differs from the assertion).

assertions.assertion: app.MapGroup("/admin") is used to group the admin endpoints
.RequireAuthorization("admin") or equivalent is applied to the group
assertions.rationale: Group has .RequireAuthorization("AdminOnly"), which applies the policy to the group.

assertions.assertion: The individual admin endpoints are registered on the group rather than on app directly
assertions.rationale: admin.MapGet("/") and admin.MapPost("/") are registered on the group.
